L0.contract: Course v1 S1-S6 with the wheeled annex. Apparatus smoke test: proves achievability by this rover; does not exclude controller, engine or fixture causes of a later failure.

L1a.contract: Course v1 standalone: initial stable hold, at least 8 strict alternating forward touchdowns, net displacement at least L, terminal stable hold for 5 seconds; complete within 60 seconds, all whole-run invariants apply.

L1b.contract: THE COURSE, segment S1 (Approach): walk from stable hold to the ramp entry. >=4 strict alternating touchdowns, cross-track <=0.15 m, path efficiency >=0.70, stance slip <=0.02 m.

L1c.contract: THE COURSE, segments S2+S3 (Descent, Advance): walk DOWN the ramp with no fall and no forbidden support, >=2 touchdowns on the ramp, stance slip <=0.06 m, arrive with both pads on the ground; then >=5 further strict alternating steps, each forward projection >0.02 m.

L1d.contract: Course v1 S1-S6 unbroken, legged annex, all frozen held-out robustness cases. Includes closed loop, ascent and return to the original plate pose; at most 240 seconds.

L2.contract: Two runs of the same inputs under TWO DIFFERENT recorded renamings produce an identical deterministicProjection(frame) after remapping references. Distinct from D1: D1 fixes the renaming seed and varies nothing, so it cannot catch identity dependence.

D1.contract: Same blueprint, input trace AND renaming seed => identical deterministicProjection(frame) hash, two processes, both clocks. The projection excludes wall-clock timings, identifier mappings and diagnostic metadata.

P1.contract: BOTH must hold on a named scene and machine, over a stated measurement duration: >=30 rendered fps AND 120 completed simulation ticks per wall-clock second, with a declared overload policy. A responsive renderer over a simulation accruing debt is not a pass. Measure before setting any budget.

S1.contract: A hostile controller cannot escape, hang, or read undeclared state.

F1.contract: F1 v2: the maintainer-designated target player accepts the basic construction experience after building something that moves within 15 minutes without live assistance, and wants to build another. Returning sessions are eligible; explicit real-player feedback and the served build are required. The latest assessment governs.

F2.contract: Instrumented: application response time across one place -> connect -> run cycle on a named reference scene and machine (input event to reflecting frame, plus Run to first tick), human thinking time excluded. p95 under 2 s, no single stall over 500 ms.

F3.contract: A player who did not build the machine can say why it failed from the post-mortem alone.

F4.contract: Ten minutes of unassisted play yields one moment of visible delight and no moment of 'I don't know what this wants from me'.

F5.contract: A player, using their own browser agent, gets an actionable answer to 'why isn't this working' without leaving the game. Judged by watching a person.

rules.rule: Layer imports follow the module graph and physical laws receive no identity.
Nine ordered phases, one integration, previous completed sensors.
Physical properties derive only from authored geometry and player selections.
Checks execute, deadlines interrupt, owners and references validate.

All five measured physical stages must pass before expanding terrain.
Course v1 and its annexes require frozen fixtures and unbroken qualification.
Players and their agents share one command surface and physical constraints.
